_what: Talyx asset bank v3. Measured, trimmed to its own attack, and loudness-matched on ingest.
_v3_changes: v2 wrote -70.0 LUFS for 9 files as if it were a measurement. It is ebur128's FLOOR - integrated loudness is undefined below ~400ms. Those files are now peak-normalised and say so. Files that could not reach target by gain alone now go through a real limiter instead of being shipped quiet.
_licence: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License - free for commercial use, no attribution. Redistributing the files as a standalone pack is NOT permitted.

_fields.role: hit = safe on a cut | gesture = align by attack | bed = ambience
_fields.loudness_method: gain = clean | limiter = needed limiting to reach target | peak_to_-3dBFS = too short for LUFS to mean anything
_fields.lufs_i: null means the file is under 400ms and integrated LUFS does not apply. It is NOT silent - check peak_dbfs.
_fields.gain_limited_db: dB still short of target AFTER limiting. 0 means it hit target.
_fields.cut_safe: true = place at the cut frame, no offset needed
